notes.title: Level 6 - Update
notes.notes:
Happy to announce, friends!


 - Level 6 added
 - Lumen reflections for enhanced visuals
 - Main character upgraded to MetaHuman (for future development and learning)
 - Improvements across all levels (updated obstacles, general fixes, added fog effects, etc.)
 - New Graphics Option (Post-Processing)
 - General optimization enhancements


Have Fun!

:)

notes.title: Level 5 Update
notes.notes:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HOBF73parCsThe latest update of my game introduces Level 5, presenting a tough challenge: don't let your friends fall, or you'll have to start over. Progress is steady as we approach a complete release. I'm optimistic about launching the full version this year, featuring well-crafted levels that offer both learning and fun. 

I hope everyone enjoys it and has a great time.


     Level 5 added!
     New button in the Main Menu to select levels—jump straight to the new ones and have fun!
     Optimized memory usage, with even more improvements in future updates.
     Small fixes and enhancements to previous levels.
